_comment: Written by the trading runs (9:30a / hourly / 3:30p ET). Never contains account numbers, broker IDs, or any account other than the sandbox.

account.note: FLAT. The account holds no position of any kind - no option, no equity - and the entire balance is settled cash. That is the finding of this run and it contradicts what this board said an hour ago. The SMR calls this file carried as held overnight were closed on 8/6 at 15:38:06 ET, filled 0.49 on both contracts for 98.00 credit, settling today. Read from the broker's own order record, not inferred: the closing order is state 'filled', direction 'credit', closing_strategy 'long_call', and its placed_agent field reads 'agentic'. The opening order at 10:46 on 8/6 reads 'user'. Deployable moves 11.98 to 109.88 and the seven-read run of an account that could not afford a single contract ends with it. Realised on the round trip: bought 2 at 0.55 and 0.59 for 114.00, sold for 98.00, -16.00 or -14.0%. Recorded and not graded here - grading is the retro's slot - but recorded plainly for it: the contract closed at 0.51 on 8/6 and is 0.72 bid now, so the 0.684 take-profit the position carried is a level today's tape would have hit. That is the cost of the exit, and it is written down in the same breath as the exit rather than left for the retro to discover.
account.closingNote: Not a closing read. This is the 09:33 open slot firing at 11:57 ET, 143 minutes late, so it stopped at the staleness guard and published no order specification. The balance and the flat position above are live and verified; the absence of an entry below is the guard, not a judgement about the tape.

entryWatch.trigger: None available - the 09:33 open slot fired 143 minutes late and the staleness guard forbids resting a specification on quotes struck that far from the slot
entryWatch.why: This is the first thing a reader should see and it is not a view about any name. The open slot carries a daily entry mandate that standing aside does not satisfy, and the mandate is explicitly overridden by the staleness guard, which is the one rule above it. 09:33 against an 11:57 firing is 143 minutes, nearly six times the 25-minute tolerance, so no specification was written and none is pending. What that costs is stated rather than buried: the account went from 11.98 deployable to 109.88 overnight, which is the first read in a week where a contract was affordable at all, and the run that could have used it was too late to be allowed to. The mandate is undischarged for 2026-08-07 and this row is the record of why. Nothing below is armed; the names carry live quotes so the board is accurate, not so it reads as a shopping list.

entryWatch.trigger: Position closed 8/6 at 15:38 ET - there is nothing to manage and no re-entry is proposed
entryWatch.why: Dead because the position is gone, not because the thesis failed. SMR is 9.95 bid, +5.1%, and printed through the 9.505 8/5 high the original thesis rested on - the structural line the setup wanted repaired is repaired today, four sessions after the setup was written. The 8/14 9.50 calls that were held are 0.72 bid against the 0.57 average, +26.3%, through the 0.684 target. None of that is actionable: the contract expires 8/14, which is 7 days out and inside the final week the rulebook bans outright, so a re-entry is forbidden by the same rule that made yesterday's exit due. Level is the live bid, carried so the board shows what the name actually did rather than the 9.39 it was carrying.

entryWatch.trigger: Reported 8/7 before the open and gapped - item 2 forbids buying the reaction bar
entryWatch.why: Reported this morning: -0.28 actual against a -0.16 estimate, verified on the live calendar. A miss, and the stock is 48.00 bid and +13.8%, the best mover on the board. That combination is exactly the bar item 2 exists to refuse - this is the reaction day, the gap is already paid for, and a +13.8% print is the top of the range the rule names. Day 2 is Monday and this setup does not carry to it as written. At 48.00 a share it is also 44% of the account in one position, which fails concentration before the tape is even argued about.

entryWatch.trigger: None - the 8/11 print sits inside any five-session hold and no straddle has been pulled
entryWatch.why: The only name on the list with a catalyst still ahead, and the only one where item 3 is a live question rather than a moot one. SMCI is 30.80 bid, +4.8%, reporting 8/11 after the close against a 0.69 estimate, verified live. A hold opened today runs four sessions to the print, so the print is inside it, so the at-the-money straddle has to be pulled and the implied move written down before any size is set. No straddle was pulled by this run, because a run stopped at the staleness guard does not get to build the entry it is not allowed to publish. Dead for today; the item stays open for Monday's slot, which is the last one that could act before the print.

candidatesAsOf: 2026-08-07 11:57 ET, live session bids read by the open run as it wrote. The Last column is the official 8/6 settled close. These are mid-session quotes, not closing marks.
candidatesNote: The account is flat with 109.88 of settled cash - the first read in seven where a contract is affordable at all - and no entry was published, because the open slot fired 143 minutes late and stopped at the staleness guard. Read the list with that in mind: these are quotes, not candidates that were worked up and refused on their merits. Breadth is 10 green of 12 and the two red are AMD at -1.3% and MARA at -4.3%. That breadth is itself an item 2 signal - IONQ +9.1%, SOUN +10.7% and OKLO +13.8% on a list where the median name is up about 5% is the whole-list-green condition the rulebook calls a wait signal rather than a buy signal - and it is worth recording that the guard and the checklist point the same way today, so nothing was lost to the lateness that item 2 would not have argued against anyway. OKLO reported this morning, missing at -0.28 against -0.16 and rallying 13.8% regardless. SMCI on 8/11 after the close is the only catalyst still ahead on this list; every other name has reported. No no-fly flags remain from the 8/5-8/6 cluster because all of those prints have landed.

candidates.note: 9.95 bid, +5.1%, and through the 9.505 8/5 high the original thesis wanted reclaimed. Not held - the 8/14 9.50 calls were closed 8/6 at 15:38 ET for 0.49 and are 0.72 bid now. The re-entry that tape would suggest is closed off by the rulebook's final-week ban: 8/14 is 7 days out. The name did what the thesis said; the instrument ran out of calendar first.

48.00 bid, +13.8%, the best mover on the board, on a miss - -0.28 actual against -0.16 estimate, verified live this morning. No longer no-fly: the print has landed. Refused on item 2 rather than on the miss, because this is the reaction bar and +13.8% is above the range the rule tolerates. At 48.00 one share is 44% of the account.

7.83 bid, +10.7%. Worth reading against yesterday: it closed 7.08 after being -11.6% from its 8.045 reaction-day open, and today it is back near that open. The 8/6 refusal was right on the day and is being handed back on day 3, which is the honest way to record it. Still refused today on breadth - a +10.7% session inside a 10-of-12 green board is not the day-2 pullback the rulebook buys.

43.33 bid, +9.1%. Now affordable at 109.88 deployable where it was not at 11.98, so the objection changes from arithmetic to structure: one share is 39% of the account and an -8% stop is 3.47 of room in a name that has travelled several dollars in a session. That is the stop-inside-the-noise problem, and it is the same objection that killed the earlier IONQ setup for a different reason.

30.80 bid, +4.8%. The only name here with a catalyst ahead - 8/11 after the close, 0.69 estimate, verified live. Any hold opened now contains the print, so item 3 binds and the at-the-money straddle has to be pulled first. It was not pulled by this run and no entry rests on it.

8.66 bid, +5.3%, and cleanly above the 8.20 line it crossed back and forth four times on 8/6. The line held on the retest, which is the first thing this name has done that resembles a structure rather than chop. Affordable now at 12 shares. Not proposed - no specification was published at all today.

30.51 bid, +2.7%, back above both the 30.20 close and the 30.32 pre-earnings line it failed at on 8/6. The structural objection is unchanged and is about 8/5, not today: an open at 34.595 to a 30.20 close on 12.3M shares against a 5.1M average gave back the entire earnings move, and one green day does not repair that.

20.32 bid, +4.7%, reclaiming the 20 line it lost yesterday. It reported 8/6 at -0.13 against a -0.10 estimate - a miss - and is bouncing with the board rather than on anything of its own. A miss is not a catalyst and a sympathy bounce is not a setup.

17.28 bid, +4.5%. Reported 8/6 after the close, so the no-fly flag it carried is spent and it drops to watch. Not held through the print and never proposed into it. Nothing here beyond participation in a green tape.

186.32 bid, +4.7%, ending a six-read run as the worst name on the board. The 73% beat that sold off for two sessions is being bought back on day 3. Unreachable regardless - one share is 170% of the account.

10.19 bid, -4.3%, the weakest name on the board and one of only two red. Reported 8/6 after the close, so the no-fly flag is spent. Selling off after its print on a day when everything else rallies is information, and it is the wrong sign for a long.
482.79 bid, -1.3%, the other red name and the only large-cap here. One share is more than four times the account. Carried for context on breadth, not as a candidate.
